added_comments.text: Tuple, not a joined string, so ids containing the separator can't collide.

rationale: The fix addresses the actual root cause: make_key didn't include tenant_id, so cache lookups could collide across tenants for any cacheable op; adding tenant_id to the key fixes the whole class of cross-tenant leakage rather than adding another op to the _UNCACHED_OPS workaround list. The diff doesn't touch the 'internal' tenant bypass logic (which lives elsewhere, gated by _UNCACHED_OPS or similar), so that protected behavior appears preserved.
